sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram Pradhans, Kshetra Panchayat Pramukhs, Zila Panchayat Presidents, and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the people, in the event of their death while in office.
**Who is this for:** Family; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Financial assistance

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Panchayat Kalyan Kosh&quot; scheme was introduced by the Panchayati Raj Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the families or dependents of Gram Pradhans, Kshetra Panchayat Pramukhs, Zila Panchayat Presidents, and all members of the three-tier Panchayat elected as representatives of the people, in the event of their death while in office (excluding cases of suicide or involvement in criminal acts).

**Benefits / Assistance:** In the event of the death of a Panchayat Representative while in office, the following amounts will be provided to their families or dependents: - Pradhan of Gram Panchayat, Pramukh of Kshetra Panchayat, and Zila Panchayat President: ₹10,00,000/- - Member of Zila Panchayat: ₹5,00,000/- - Member of Kshetra Panchayat: ₹3,00,000/- - Member of Gram Panchayat: ₹2,00,000/-

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** Family members or dependents of the deceased Panchayat representatives should apply directly through the [official website](https://prdfinance.up.gov.in/self_registration_kalyankosh_ben) of the Panchayati Raj Department, Uttar Pradesh. **Step 2:** During registration on the Panchayat Kalyan Kosh portal, the dependent must fill out the application form in the prescribed format ([Appendix-1](https://prdfinance.up.gov.in/dist_pdf_kalyankosh/pk_niyamavli.pdf)) and upload the necessary documents. **Step 3:** The District Panchayat Raj Officer will download the application submitted by the dependent from their login ID and obtain approval from the District Magistrate after a thorough review. **Step 4:** Once approved by the District Magistrate, the District Panchayat Raj Officer will forward the application form to the Director of Panchayati Raj from their login ID for fund transfer.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Panchayati Raj Department, Uttar Pradesh
**Tags:** Panchayat Representative, Death, Financial Assiatance, Panchayat
